defining_need_fit.caveat: The Shopify integration evidence explicitly states it does not establish whether AI Answers can read the sidebar order data, and no selected evidence describes VIP or complexity-based routing, so only the agent-facing order lookup/actions and Docs-based deflection of common questions are established.
defining_need_fit.why: Components of the stated workflow are documented — Shopify order status/refund actions in the sidebar, a shared inbox, and AI Answers drawing on Docs with human handoff — but the two defining mechanisms, order-data-driven deflection and VIP/complex routing, are not established by the selected evidence.

ranked_relevance.why: Documents the exact sidebar order-status, receipt and tracking lookup named in the audience's workflow, with its install condition and its stated silence on AI access.
Defines the AI billing unit as one conversation resolved without human assistance or escalation, which is precisely the 'what counts as one' check this audience makes.
States the documented $0.75-per-resolution AI price, a figure this audience compares against per-ticket plan maths.
States how the AI mechanism behaves — instant in-app answers drawn from Docs and other knowledge sources with handoff to a human — which is the deflection path in the stated workflow.
States that AI Answers handles common questions instantly and workflow automations keep the team organized, supporting the repeat-question deflection claim.
Documents full order detail view plus refund, cancel, edit and duplicate actions in the sidebar, covering the refund half of the stated question mix for agents.
Describes the Improvements mechanism by which missing context is added from a conversation and the AI learns from it, a required capability of this segment.
Describes Suggested Improvements surfacing pre-drafted updates approved with a click, the second required capability and the low-effort path to better deflection.
Describes the shared-inbox mechanism giving all teammates queue access and customer context, the container for a founder-plus-small-team setup.
Gives a dated AI volume ramp (36 conversations in week one to nearly 300 per week by August 2025) at one non-ecommerce customer, useful as scale evidence rather than a present trigger.
A customer's framing that AI takes the simple questions while the team keeps the high-touch ones matches this audience's routine-versus-judgment split, though it is an opinion, not a mechanism.
Shows a multi-inbox plus Docs knowledge-base self-service configuration of the kind this workflow assumes, at a bike retailer.

problem_fits.caveat: The Shopify integration evidence states it does not establish whether AI Answers can read the sidebar order data, so automated answering of 'where's my order' from live order status is not established by the selected evidence.
problem_fits.why: Agents get order status, tracking and refund actions in the sidebar and AI Answers deflects common questions from Docs with human handoff, but the order-data-driven half of WISMO deflection is unestablished.

problem_fits.caveat: Only the AI add-on unit and price are in the selected evidence — $0.75 per resolution, billed once per conversation and only when the customer does not escalate, search the knowledge base or ask more questions — while the underlying plan prices and any overage terms are not established here.
problem_fits.why: The ledger answers this audience's exact billing-unit question for the AI layer but does not establish total cost per ticket at their volume.

segment_objections.objection: If the AI cannot read my Shopify order data, it cannot actually answer 'where's my order', so the deflection only covers generic FAQ questions.
segment_objections.answer: Documented behaviour is that AI Answers draws on Docs and other knowledge sources with handoff to a human, while order status, receipts and tracking are documented as appearing in the agent sidebar; AI access to that sidebar data is not established by the selected evidence.

segment_objections.objection: Per-resolution AI pricing makes my monthly cost unpredictable as volume grows.
segment_objections.answer: A resolution is defined as a single conversation resolved by AI without human assistance, billed once per conversation even with multiple AI replies, and not counted if the customer escalates, searches the knowledge base or asks for more help, at $0.75 per resolution.
